entries.name: Adjust Reality
entries.text: After you or a willing ally make any roll, you can **spend 5 Hope** to change the numerical result of that roll to a result of your choice instead. The result must be plausible within the range of the dice.

entries.name: Arcana-Touched
entries.text:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Arcana domain, gain the following benefits:

- +1 bonus to your Spellcast Rolls
- Once per rest, you can switch the results of your Hope and Fear Dice.

entries.name: Arcane Reflection

report.text: If any die shows 6, the GM reflects the incoming magic attack to its caster instead.

entries.name: Armorer
entries.text:
While you’re wearing armor, gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Score.

During a rest, when you choose to repair your armor as a downtime move, your allies also clear an Armor Slot.

entries.name: Astral Projection
entries.text:
Once per long rest, **mark a Stress** to create a projected copy of yourself that can appear anywhere you’ve been before.

You can see and hear through the projection as though it were you and affect the world as though you were there. A creature investigating the projection can tell it’s of magical origin. This effect lasts until your next rest or your projection takes any damage.

entries.name: Avatar of Terror
entries.text:
**Mark a Stress** to transform into a creature fueled by fear. While in this form, you gain a **1d6** bonus to your damage rolls for each Fear in the GM’s pool. Additionally, you gain a Hope when the GM spends a Fear to spotlight an adversary within Very Close range.

Before you make an action roll, you must spend a Hope. If you can’t, you revert to your normal form.

entries.name: Banish
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Close range. On a success, roll a number of **d20**s equal to your Spellcast trait. The target must make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to your highest result. On a success, the target must mark a Stress but isn’t banished. Once per rest on a failure, they are banished from this realm.

When the PCs roll with Fear, the Difficulty gains a −1 penalty and the target makes another reaction roll. On a success, they return from banishment.

entries.name: Bare Bones
entries.text:
When you choose not to equip armor, you have a base Armor Score of 3 + your Strength and use the following as your base damage thresholds:

- ***Tier 1:*** 9/19
- ***Tier 2:*** 11/24
- ***Tier 3:*** 13/31
- ***Tier 4:*** 15/38

entries.name: Battle Cry

effect.text: Unseen while stationary. Remove when moving into or within an adversary line of sight; ends automatically when attacking.

entries.name: Codex-Touched
entries.text:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Codex domain, gain the following benefits:

- You can **mark a Stress** to add your Proficiency to a Spellcast Roll.
- Once per rest, replace this card with any card from your vault without paying its Recall Cost.

entries.name: Confusing Aura
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (14)**. Once per long rest on a success, you create a layer of illusion over your body that makes it hard to tell exactly where you are. **Mark any number of Stress** to make that many additional layers. When an adversary makes an attack against you, roll a number of **d6s** equal to the number of layers currently active. If any roll a 5 or higher, one layer of the aura is destroyed and the attack fails. If all the results are 4 or lower, you take the damage and this spell ends.

effect.name: Confusing Aura
effect.text: Roll a d6 per layer when attacked. Any 5+ prevents the attack and destroys one layer; otherwise the aura ends.

entries.name: Conjure Swarm
entries.text:
***Tekaira Armored Beetles:*Mark a Stress** to conjure armored beetles that encircle you. When you next take damage, reduce the severity by one threshold. You can **spend a Hope** to keep the beetles conjured after taking damage.

***Fire Flies:*** Make a **Spellcast Roll** against all adversaries within Close range. **Spend a Hope** to deal **2d8+3** magic damage to targets you succeeded against.

spells.text: ***Tekaira Armored Beetles:*Mark a Stress** to conjure armored beetles that encircle you. When you next take damage, reduce the severity by one threshold. You can **spend a Hope** to keep the beetles conjured after taking damage.

effect.name: Tekaira Armored Beetles
effect.text: Reduce the next damage severity by one; spend a Hope to retain the beetles.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Fire Flies: spend a Hope, roll 2d8+3 damage

entries.name: Conjured Steeds
entries.text: **Spend any number of Hope** to conjure that many magical steeds (such as horses, camels, or elephants) that you and your allies can ride until your next long rest or the steeds take any damage. The steeds double your land speed while traveling and, when in danger, allow you to move within Far range without having to roll. Creatures riding a steed gain a −2 penalty to attack rolls and a +2 bonus to damage rolls.

effect.name: Conjured Steed
effect.text: Double land travel speed; move within Far range without a roll in danger. Remove when the steed takes damage. Unselect mounted options when dismounted.

effect.name: Conjured Steed
effect.text: Double land travel speed; move within Far range without a roll in danger. Remove when the steed takes damage. Unselect mounted options when dismounted.

report.text: Conjured one steed per Hope spent. Claim a steed only while one is available.

entries.name: Copycat
entries.text: Once per long rest, this card can mimic the features of another domain card of level 8 or lower in another player’s loadout. **Spend Hope equal to half the card’s level** to gain access to the feature. It lasts until your next rest or they place the card in their vault.

entries.name: Corrosive Projectile
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Far range. On a success, deal **d6+4** magic damage using your Proficiency. Additionally, **mark 2 or more Stress** to make them permanently *Corroded*. While a target is *Corroded*, they gain a −1 penalty to their Difficulty for every 2 Stress you spent. This condition can stack.

entries.name: Counterspell

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Successful Counterspell: stop effect and vault

report.text: The magical effect stops and its consequences are avoided.

entries.text: You can interrupt a magical effect taking place by making a reaction roll using your Spellcast trait. On a success, the effect stops and any consequences are avoided, and this card is placed in your vault.

entries.name: Crimson Adamance
entries.text: When you would mark your last Hit Point, **spend a Hope** to **mark a Stress** instead.

mitigation.label: Crimson Adamance
mitigation.description: Spend a Hope and mark a Stress instead of marking your last Hit Point.

entries.name: Critical Inspiration
entries.text: Once per rest, when you critically succeed on an attack, all allies within Very Close range can clear a Stress or gain a Hope.

chatBenefits.label: Within Very Close range: clear 1 Stress
Within Very Close range: gain 1 Hope

entries.name: Cruel Precision
entries.text: When you make a successful attack with a weapon, gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to either your Finesse or Agility.

rollOptions.label: Cruel Precision
rollOptions.description: Use only after a successful weapon attack.

entries.name: Damnation
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Far range. On a success, **mark any number of Stress** to roll an equal number of **d20s**, dealing magic damage equal to the total result. If this attack defeats the target, all adversaries within Far range of the target must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Dark Army
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (14)**. Once per long rest on a success, you can summon fiends that surround and move with you. Place 8 tokens on this card. When you deal damage to a target within Very Close range, you can spend any number of tokens to add **1d8** for each token spent to your damage roll. Additionally, when you take damage, you can spend any number of tokens to reduce the damage by **1d8** for each token spent. Each time you spend a token, a fiend acts on your behalf, then disappears.

When you take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.

rollOptions.label: Dark Army fiend
rollOptions.description: Only a target within Very Close range.

entries.name: Dark Whispers
entries.text:
You can speak into the mind of any person with whom you’ve made physical contact. Once you’ve opened a channel with them, they can speak back into your mind. Additionally, you can **mark a Stress** to make a **Spellcast Roll** against them. On a success, you can ask the GM one of the following questions and receive an answer:

- Where are they?
- What are they doing?
- What are they afraid of?
- What do they cherish most in the world?

entries.name: Darkfire
entries.text: Once per scene, **spend any number of Hope** to target an equal number of adversaries within Close range. Each target makes a **Reaction Roll (15)**. Targets who fail take **d8+6** magic damage using your Spellcast trait as they are engulfed in dark fire. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Deadly Focus
entries.text: Once per rest, you can apply all your focus toward a target of your choice. Until you attack another creature, you defeat the target, or the battle ends, gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

effect.name: Deadly Focus
effect.text: End this effect if you attack another creature, defeat the target, or the battle ends.

entries.name: Death Grip

report.text: Apply only to intervening adversaries who fail their Reaction Roll (13).

entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Close range and choose one of the following options:

- You pull the target into Melee range or pull yourself into Melee range of them.
- You constrict the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.
- All adversaries between you and the target must succeed on a Reaction Roll (13) or be hit by vines, taking **3d6+2** physical damage.
On a success, vines reach out from your hands, causing the chosen effect and temporarily *Restraining* the target.

entries.name: Deathrun
entries.text:
**Spend 3 Hope** to run a straight path through the battlefield to a point within Far range, making an attack against all adversaries within your weapon’s range along that path. Choose the order in which you deal damage to the targets you succeeded against. For the first, roll your weapon damage with a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Then remove a die from your damage roll and deal the remaining damage to the next target. Continue to remove a die for each subsequent target until you have no more damage dice or adversaries.

You can’t target the same adversary more than once per attack.

entries.name: Deft Deceiver
entries.text: **Spend a Hope** to gain advantage on a roll to deceive or trick someone into believing a lie you tell them.

rollOptions.label: Deft Deceiver
rollOptions.description: A roll to deceive or trick someone into believing a lie.

entries.name: Deft Maneuvers
entries.text:
Once per rest,**mark a Stress** to sprint anywhere within Far range without making an Agility Roll to get there.

If you end this movement within Melee range of an adversary and immediately make an attack against them, gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll.

entries.name: Delerium Grasp
entries.text:
Contaminated Cinder Grasp

Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, give the GM a Fear to have the target instantly burst into eldritch flames, taking d12+3 magic damage using your proficiency and become temporarily *Consumed by Octarine Flame*. If the target takes Severe damage from this attack, they must mark a Stress or gain 1 Contamination Level.

 When a creature acts while *Consumed by Octarin*e Flame, they must take an additional 2d6 magic damage and mark a Stress if they are still *Consumed by Octarine Flame* at the end of their action.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Delerium Grasp: give the GM a Fear, roll d12+3 damage

entries.name: Dire Strike
entries.text: When a target marks any number of Hit Points from an attack you make, you can **spend a Hope** to drain power from them. The GM loses a Fear.

entries.name: Disintegration Wave
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (18)**. Once per long rest on a success, the GM tells you which adversaries within Far range have a Difficulty of 18 or lower. **Mark a Stress** for each one you wish to hit with this spell. They are killed and can’t come back to life by any means.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Disintegration Wave: mark Stress and kill one eligible target

report.text: Choose one GM-identified adversary within Far range with Difficulty 18 or lower to kill. Mark 1 Stress; repeat this option once per target you choose.

entries.name: Divination
entries.text: Once per long rest, **spend 3 Hope** to reach out to the forces beyond and ask one “yes or no” question about an event, person, place, or situation in the near future. For a moment, the present falls away and you see the answer before you.

entries.name: Dread-Touched
entries.text:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Dread domain, gain the following benefits:

- When you succeed with Fear, you can **mark 2* *Stress** to prevent the GM from gaining a Fear.
- Once per rest when making an action roll, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of Fear in the GM’s pool.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Dread-Touched: prevent GM Fear on success
conditionalRollTriggers.description: Use only after a successful Fear roll; the GM handles the prevented Fear.

entries.name: Earthquake
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (16)**. Once per rest on a success, all targets within Very Far range who aren’t flying must make a Reaction Roll (18). Targets who fail take **3d10+8** physical damage and are temporarily *Vulnerable*. Targets who succeed take half damage.

Additionally, when you succeed on the Spellcast Roll, all terrain within Very Far range becomes difficult to move through and structures within this range might sustain damage or crumble.

report.text: Targets failing Reaction (18) take full damage and become Vulnerable; successful targets take half. Terrain becomes difficult.

entries.name: Eclipse
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (16)**. Once per long rest on a success, plunge the entire area within Far range into complete darkness only you and your allies can see through. Attack rolls have disadvantage when targeting you or an ally within this shadow.

Additionally, when you or an ally succeeds with Hope against an adversary within this shadow, the target must mark a Stress.

This spell lasts until the GM spends a **Fear** on their turn to clear this effect or you take Severe damage.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Eclipse

report.text: The area within Far range is plunged into darkness only you and your allies can see through. Attacks against you and allies in the shadow have disadvantage; when you or an ally succeeds with Hope against an adversary in the shadow, it marks a Stress. Ends when the GM spends a Fear on their turn or you take Severe damage.

conditionalRollTriggers.description: Plunge the area within Far range into darkness only you and your allies can see through. Attacks against you and allies in the shadow have disadvantage; successful attacks with Hope against adversaries there cause them to mark a Stress. Ends when the GM spends a Fear on their turn or you take Severe damage.

entries.name: Eldritch Flesh
entries.text:
Gain a +1 bonus to your damage thresholds for each Stress you have marked.

Additionally, when you roll with Fear, you can **spend 2 Hope** to clear an Armor Slot.

entries.name: Encore
entries.text: When an ally within Close range deals damage to an adversary, you can make a **Spellcast Roll** against that same target. On a success, you deal the same damage to the target that your ally dealt. If your Spellcast Roll succeeds with Fear, place this card in your vault.

entries.name: Endless Charisma
entries.text: After you make an action roll to persuade, lie, or garner favor, you can **spend a Hope** to reroll the Hope or Fear Die.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Endless Charisma: reroll Hope Die
conditionalRollTriggers.description: Use after a social action roll; the GM confirms whether it was to persuade, lie, or garner favor.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Endless Charisma: reroll Fear Die
conditionalRollTriggers.description: Use after a social action roll; the GM confirms whether it was to persuade, lie, or garner favor.

entries.name: Enrapture
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Close range. On a success, they become temporarily *Enraptured*. While *Enraptured*, a target’s attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice. Once per rest on a success, you can **mark a Stress** to force the *Enraptured* target to mark a Stress as well.

entries.name: Falling Sky
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against all adversaries within Far range. **Mark any number of Stress** to make shards of arcana rain down from above. Targets you succeed against take **1d20+2** magic damage for each Stress marked.

entries.name: Fane of the Wilds
entries.text:
After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to the number of Sage domain cards in your loadout and vault on this card.

When you would make a Spellcast Roll, you can spend any number of tokens after the roll to gain a +1 bonus for each token spent.

When you critically succeed on a Spellcast Roll for a Sage domain spell, gain a token.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Fane of the Wilds: spend tokens
Critical Sage spell: gain a token

entries.name: Ferocity
entries.text: When you cause an adversary to mark 1 or more Hit Points, you can **spend 2 Hope** to increase your Evasion by the number of Hit Points they marked. This bonus lasts until after the next attack made against you.

entries.name: Final Words
entries.text: You can infuse a corpse with a moment of life to speak with it. Make a **Spellcast Roll (13)**. On a success with Hope, the corpse answers up to three questions. On a success with Fear, the corpse answers one question. The corpse answers truthfully, but it can’t impart information it didn’t know in life. On a failure, or once the corpse has finished answering your questions, the body turns to dust.

entries.name: Flight
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (15)**. On a success, place a number of tokens equal to your Agility on this card (minimum 1). When you make an action roll while flying, spend a token from this card. After the action that spends the last token is resolved, you descend to the ground directly below you.

effect.name: Flight
effect.text: Flying. Spend a token on each action roll while flying; descend after the last token.

entries.name: Floating Eye
entries.text: **Spend a Hope** to create a single, small floating orb that you can move anywhere within Very Far range. While this spell is active, you can see through the orb as though you’re looking out from its position. You can transition between using your own senses and seeing through the orb freely. If the orb takes damage or moves out of range, the spell ends.

entries.name: Forager
entries.text:
As an additional downtime move you can choose, roll a d6 to see what you forage. Work with the GM to describe it and add it to your inventory as a consumable. Your party can carry up to five foraged consumables at a time.

- A unique food (Clear 2 Stress)

- A beautiful relic (Gain 2 Hope)

- An arcane rune (+2 to a Spellcast Roll)

- A healing vial (Clear 2 Hit Points)

- A luck charm (Reroll any die)

- Choose one of the options above.

outcomes: An arcane rune (consumable: +2 to a Spellcast Roll)
A luck charm (consumable: reroll any die)
Choose one of the options above

entries.name: Force of Nature
entries.text:
**Mark a Stress** to transform into a hulking nature spirit, gaining the following benefits:

- When you succeed on an attack or Spellcast Roll, gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll.
- When you deal enough damage to defeat a creature within Close range, you absorb them and clear an Armor Slot.
- You can’t be *Restrained*.
Before you make an action roll, you must **spend a Hope**. If you can’t, you revert to your normal form.

effect.name: Force of Nature
effect.text: Cannot be Restrained. Spend Hope before every action or revert. Clear Armor only when defeating a creature within Close range.

rollTriggers.label: Defeated creature within Close: clear Armor

entries.name: Forceful Push
entries.text:
Make an attack with your primary weapon against a target within Melee range. On a success, you deal damage and knock them back to Close range. On a success with Hope, add a **d6** to your damage roll.

Additionally, you can **spend a Hope** to make them temporarily *Vulnerable*.

rollOptions.label: Forceful Push
rollOptions.description: Primary weapon Melee attack succeeds with Hope; knockback manual.

entries.name: Forest Sprites
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (13)**. On a success, **spend any number of Hope** to create an equal number of small forest sprites who appear at points you choose within Far range, providing the following benefits:

- Your allies gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls against adversaries within Melee range of a sprite.
- An ally who marks an Armor Slot while within Melee range of a sprite can mark an additional Armor Slot.
A sprite vanishes after granting a benefit or taking any damage.

effect.name: Forest Sprites source
effect.text: Use only within Melee range of a sprite. Each attack bonus or additional Armor Slot consumes one shared sprite.

entries.name: Fortified Armor
entries.text: While you are wearing armor, gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.text:
Once per long rest, you can go into a *Frenzy* until there are no more adversaries within sight.

While *Frenzied*, you can’t use Armor Slots, and you gain a +10 bonus to your damage rolls and a +8 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

effect.name: Frenzied
effect.text: End this effect when no adversaries remain in sight.

entries.name: Full Surge
entries.text: Once per long rest, **mark 3 Stress** to push your body to its limits. Gain a +2 bonus to all of your character traits until your next rest.

effect.name: Full Surge
effect.text: Full Surge

entries.name: Get Back Up
entries.text: When you take Severe damage, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the severity by one threshold.

entries.name: Gifted Tracker

report.text: Ask one listed tracking question. Evasion is +1 only against creatures tracked this way.

entries.text:
When you’re tracking a specific creature or group of creatures based on signs of their passage, you **can spend any number of Hope** and ask the GM that many questions from the following list.

- What direction did they go?
- How long ago did they pass through?
- What were they doing in this location?
- How many of them were here?
When you encounter creatures you’ve tracked in this way, gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion against them.

entries.name: Glancing Blow
entries.text: When you fail an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to deal weapon damage using half your Proficiency.

entries.name: Glyph of Hemorrhaging
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a creature within Far range. On a success, **mark a Hit Point** to sear the target with a magical glyph that lasts until the GM spends 2 Fear to remove it or you take Severe damage. Whenever the target marks any Hit Points while the glyph remains, you can **mark a Stress** to make them mark an additional Hit Point.

effect.name: Glyph of Hemorrhaging
effect.text: Whenever the glyph's target marks HP, mark 1 Stress to make them mark 1 additional HP. Ends when you take Severe damage or the GM spends 2 Fear to remove it.

actions.label: Glyph target marks HP: force another HP

report.text: The glyph's target marks 1 additional HP.

entries.name: Glyph of Nightfall

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Successful Glyph of Nightfall
conditionalRollTriggers.description: Temporarily reduce the target's Difficulty by your Knowledge (minimum 1), applied by the GM.

entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Very Close range. On a success, **spend a Hope** to conjure a dark glyph upon their body that exposes their weak points, temporarily reducing the target’s Difficulty by a value equal to your Knowledge (minimum 1).

entries.name: Goad Them On
entries.text: Describe how you taunt a target within Close range, then make a **Presence Roll** against them. On a success, the target must mark a Stress, and the next time the GM spotlights them, they must target you with an attack, which they make with disadvantage.

entries.name: Gore and Glory
entries.text:
When you critically succeed on a weapon attack, gain an additional Hope or clear an additional Stress.

Additionally, when you deal enough damage to defeat an enemy, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

actions.label: Qualifying critical or defeat: gain Hope
Qualifying critical or defeat: clear Stress

entries.name: Grace-Touched

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Grace-Touched: target marks Stress, not HP
conditionalRollTriggers.description: Replace the HP this damage would force the target to mark with the same number of Stress; apply it at the table.

entries.text:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Grace domain, gain the following benefits:

- You can **mark an Armor Slot** instead of marking a Stress.
- When you would force a target to mark a number of Hit Points, you can choose instead to force them to mark that number of Stress.

entries.name: Grisly Harpoon
entries.text:
You launch a harpoon of blood at a location or creature within Far range. If the target is a location, make a **Spellcast Roll(13)**. On a success, **mark a Stress** to pull yourself to a position within Melee range of it.

If the target is a creature, make a **Spellcast Roll** against it. On a success, **mark a Stress** to deal **3d8** magic damage to the target. You then pull the target straight toward yourself or pull yourself straight toward the target, ending within Melee range of each other.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Grisly Harpoon: mark a Stress, roll 3d8 damage

entries.name: Ground Pound
entries.text: **Spend 2 Hope** to strike the ground where you stand and make a **Strength Roll** against all targets within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against are thrown back to Far range and must make a Reaction Roll (17). Targets who fail take **4d10+8** damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Healing Field
entries.text:
Once per long rest, you can conjure a field of healing plants around you. Everywhere within Close range of you bursts to life with vibrant nature, allowing you and all allies in the area to clear a Hit Point.

**Spend 2 Hope** to allow you and all allies to clear 2 Hit Points instead.

entries.name: Healing Hands
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (13)** and target a creature other than yourself within Melee range. On a success, **mark a Stress** to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress on the target. On a failure, **mark a Stress** to clear a Hit Point or a Stress on the target. You can’t heal the same target again until your next long rest.

entries.name: Healing Strike
entries.text: When you deal damage to an adversary, you can **spend 2 Hope** to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.

entries.name: Hideous Retribution
entries.text: When an ally within Close range takes damage from a target you can see, you can make a reaction roll against the target using your Spellcast trait. On a success, **mark a Stress** to deal **d6** magic damage using your Proficiency.

entries.name: Hold the Line

effect.name: Hold the Line
effect.text: Ends on movement, failed Fear roll or the GM spending 2 Fear.

report.text: Track your stance and affected enemies. Ends on movement, failed Fear roll or the GM spending 2 Fear.

entries.text:
Describe the defensive stance you take and **spend a Hope**. If an adversary moves within Very Close range, they’re pulled into Melee range and *Restrained**.*

This condition lasts until you move or fail a roll with Fear, or the GM spends 2 Fear on their turn to clear it.

entries.name: Hush

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Successful Hush: spend Hope
conditionalRollTriggers.description: Targets are Silenced. End on recast, Major damage or GM Fear; target tracking is manual.

entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Close range. On a success, **spend a Hope** to conjure suppressive magic around the target that encompasses everything within Very Close range of them and follows them as they move.

The target and anything within the area is *Silenced *until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear this condition, you cast Hush again, or you take Major damage. While *Silenced*, they can’t make noise and can’t cast spells.

entries.name: Hypnotic Shimmer
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against all adversaries in front of you within Close range. Once per rest on a success, create an illusion of flashing colors and lights that temporarily *Stuns* targets you succeed against and forces them to mark a Stress. While *Stunned*, they can’t use reactions and can’t take any other actions until they clear this condition.

entries.name: I Am Your Shield
entries.text: When an ally within Very Close range would take damage, you can **mark a Stress** to stand in the way and make yourself the target of the attack instead. When you take damage from this attack, you can mark any number of Armor Slots.

mitigation.label: I Am Your Shield
mitigation.description: Taking the damage for an ally: you can mark any number of Armor Slots.

entries.name: I See It Coming
entries.text: When you’re targeted by an attack made from beyond Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to roll a **d4** and gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to the result against the attack.

sendRoll.label: I See It Coming - Evasion against this attack

entries.name: Inevitable
entries.text: When you fail an action roll, your next action roll has advantage.

entries.name: Inspirational Words
entries.text:
Your speech is imbued with power. After a long rest, place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Presence. When you speak with an ally, you can spend a token from this card to give them one benefit from the following options:

- Your ally clears a Stress.
- Your ally clears a Hit Point.
- Your ally gains a Hope.
When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

report.text: The ally clears 1 Stress.
The ally clears 1 Hit Point.
The ally gains 1 Hope.

entries.name: Invigoration

report.text: If any die shows 6, the chosen nearby character manually restores the chosen feature's exhaustion use.

entries.text: When you or an ally within Close range has used a feature that has an exhaustion limit (such as once per rest or once per session), you can **spend any number of Hope** and roll that many **d6s**. If any roll a 6, the feature can be used again.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (10)**. On a success, **mark a Stress** and choose yourself or an ally within Melee range to become *Invisible*. An *Invisible* creature can’t be seen except through magical means and attack rolls against them are made with disadvantage. Place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Spellcast trait. When the *Invisible* creature takes an action, spend a token from this card. After the action that spends the last token is resolved, the effect ends.

You can only hold Invisibility on one creature at a time.

effect.name: Invisibility
effect.text: Invisible: unseen except by magical means; attacks against you have disadvantage. Each selected action roll spends one token on the caster's Invisibility card. The effect ends after the last-token action resolves.

rollOptions.label: Invisibility: spend token
rollOptions.description: Spend one token on the caster's card when this action roll resolves.

entries.name: Invoke Torment

rollOptions.label: Invoke Torment: target has full Stress
rollOptions.description: Confirm the target has all Stress marked.

actions.label: Close adversary defeated with full Stress: gain Hope

entries.text:
You deal double damage to targets that have all their Stress marked.

Additionally, when an adversary within Close range is defeated with all its Stress marked, you gain a Hope.

entries.name: Jump Scare
entries.text: When you deal magic damage to a target, you can **mark a Stress** to teleport into Melee range with them. When you do, they are *Vulnerable* until they mark 1 or more Hit Points.

entries.name: Know Thy Enemy
entries.text:
When observing a creature, you can make an **Instinct Roll** against them. On a success, **spend a Hope** and ask the GM for one set of information about the target from the following options:

- Their unmarked Hit Points and Stress.
- Their Difficulty and damage thresholds.
- Their tactics and standard attack damage dice.
- Their features and Experiences.
Additionally on a success, you can **mark a Stress** to remove a Fear from the GM’s Fear Pool.

rollTriggers.label: Successful Instinct roll: ask for information
Successful Instinct roll: remove GM Fear

entries.name: Lead by Example
entries.text: When you deal damage to an adversary, you can **mark a Stress** and describe how you encourage your allies. The next PC to make an attack against that adversary can clear a Stress or gain a Hope.

chatBenefits.label: Next attack against this adversary: clear 1 Stress
Next attack against this adversary: gain 1 Hope

entries.name: Lean on Me
entries.text: Once per long rest, when you console or inspire an ally who failed an action roll, you can both clear 2 Stress.

actions.label: Lean on Me: console or inspire an ally

entries.name: Life Leash
entries.text: **Spend a Hope** to allow yourself and a willing ally within Far range to redistribute marked Hit Points between the two of you. You then can’t target that ally again with Life Leash until you finish a rest.

entries.name: Life Ward
entries.text:
**Spend 3 Hope** and choose an ally within Close range. They are marked with a glowing sigil of protection. When this ally would make a death move, they clear a Hit Point instead.

This effect ends when it saves the target from a death move, you cast Life Ward on another target, or you take a long rest.

effect.name: Life Ward
effect.text: Clear 1 HP instead of making a death move. Ends when used, when the caster recasts Life Ward, or on the caster's long rest (not the target's).

manual: Confirm the target is an ally within Close range before casting; map coordinates do not establish range automatically.

entries.name: Lifeblood Talisman
entries.text: **Mark a Hit Point** to conjure a talisman infused with your life essence. The talisman appears in your hand, and whoever carries the talisman gains its benefit: Whenever the talisman’s bearer marks 2 or more Hit Points, they can **spend a Hope** to reduce the number of Hit Points marked by 1. The talisman disappears if you have no Hit Points marked or you use this spell again.

entries.name: Manifest Wall
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (15)**. Once per rest on a success, **spend a Hope** to create a temporary magical wall between two points within Far range. It can be up to 50 feet high and form at any angle. Creatures or objects in its path are shunted to a side of your choice. The wall stays up until your next rest or you cast Manifest Wall again.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Successful Manifest Wall: spend Hope and create wall

report.text: Spend 1 Hope to create the wall; choose its geometry and resolve shunting creatures or objects manually.

entries.name: Mass Disguise
entries.text:
When you have a few minutes of silence to focus, you can **mark a Stress** to change the appearance of all willing creatures within Close range. Their new forms must share a general body structure and size, and can be somebody or something you’ve seen before or entirely fabricated. A disguised creature has advantage on Presence Rolls to avoid scrutiny.

Activate a Countdown (8). It ticks down as a consequence the GM chooses. When it triggers, the disguise drops.

entries.name: Mass Enrapture
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against all targets within Far range. Targets you succeed against become temporarily *Enraptured*. While *Enraptured*, a target’s attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice. **Mark a Stress** to force all *Enraptured* targets to mark a Stress, ending this spell.

entries.name: Master of the Craft
entries.text: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to two of your Experiences or a permanent +3 bonus to one of your Experiences. Then place this card in your vault permanently.

entries.name: Mending Touch
entries.text:
You lay your hands upon a creature and channel healing magic to close their wounds. When you can take a few minutes to focus on the target you’re helping, you can **spend 2 Hope** to clear a Hit Point or a Stress on them.

Once per long rest, when you spend this healing time learning something new about them or revealing something about yourself, you can clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress on them instead.

actions.label: Mending Touch: clear 2 HP (once per long rest)
Mending Touch: clear 2 Stress (once per long rest)

entries.name: Midnight Spirit
entries.text:
**Spend a Hope** to summon a humanoid-sized spirit that can move or carry things for you until your next rest.

You can also send it to attack an adversary. When you do, make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Very Far range. On a success, the spirit moves into Melee range with that target. Roll a number of **d6s** equal to your Spellcast trait and deal that much magic damage to the target. The spirit then dissipates. You can only have one spirit at a time.

effect.name: Midnight Spirit
effect.text: One summoned spirit. It dissipates after dealing its attack damage.

entries.name: Midnight-Touched
entries.text:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Midnight domain, gain the following benefits:

- Once per rest, when you have 0 Hope and the GM would gain a Fear, you can gain a Hope instead.
- When you make a successful attack, you can **mark a Stress** to add the result of your Fear Die to your damage roll.

conditionalActions.label: Midnight-Touched: gain Hope instead of GM Fear

conditionalRollOptions.label: Midnight-Touched: add attack Fear die
conditionalRollOptions.description: Use after a successful attack; confirm the Fear die when not rolling damage from its chat result.

entries.name: Mutual Suffering
entries.text: When an attack from a creature causes you to mark one or more Hit Points, you can make a **Reaction Roll** using your Spellcast trait against the creature. On a success, the creature marks the same number of Hit Points as you did, and you can’t use this spell again until you finish a rest.

report.text: The attacking creature marks the same number of HP you marked from its attack. Mutual Suffering is spent until your next rest.

entries.name: Natural Familiar
entries.text:
**Spend a Hope** to summon a small nature spirit or forest critter to your side until your next rest, you cast Natural Familiar again, or the familiar is targeted by an attack. If you **spend an additional Hope**, you can summon a familiar that flies. You can communicate with them, make a **Spellcast Roll** to command them to perform simple tasks, and **mark a Stress** to see through their eyes.

When you deal damage to an adversary within Melee range of your familiar, you add a **d6** to your damage roll.

conditionalRollOptions.label: Natural Familiar
conditionalRollOptions.description: Adversary is in Melee of your active familiar.

effect.name: Natural Familiar
effect.text: Dismiss when the familiar is targeted by an attack. Position and tasks are table-managed.

effect.name: Natural Familiar
effect.text: Flying familiar. Dismiss when targeted by an attack. Position and tasks are table-managed.

entries.name: Nature’s Tongue
entries.text:
You can speak the language of the natural world. When you want to speak to the plants and animals around you, make an **Instinct Roll (12)**. On a success, they’ll give you the information they know. On a roll with Fear, their knowledge might be limited or come at a cost.

Additionally, before you make a Spellcast Roll while within a natural environment, you can **spend a Hope** to gain a +2 bonus to the roll.

rollOptions.label: Nature’s Tongue
rollOptions.description: Only within a natural environment.

entries.name: Never Upstaged
entries.text: When you mark 1 or more Hit Points from an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to place a number of tokens equal to the number of Hit Points you marked on this card. On your next successful attack, gain a +5 bonus to your damage roll for each token on this card, then clear all tokens.

mitigation.label: When marking HP from an attack: gain tokens
mitigation.description: Gain one token per Hit Point actually marked from this attack.

rollOptions.label: Never Upstaged: spend ALL tokens
rollOptions.description: Spend all tokens on your next successful attack, adding +5 damage per token.

entries.name: Night Terror
entries.text: Once per long rest, choose any targets within Very Close range to perceive you as a nightmarish horror. The targets must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or become temporarily *Horrified*. While *Horrified*, they’re *Vulnerable*. Steal a number of Fear from the GM equal to the number of targets that are *Horrified* (up to the number of Fear in the GM’s pool). Roll a number of **d6s** equal to the number of stolen Fear and deal the total damage to each *Horrified* target. Discard the stolen Fear.

entries.name: Not Good Enough
entries.text: When you roll your damage dice, you can reroll any 1s or 2s.

entries.name: Notorious
entries.text:
People know who you are and what you’ve done, and they treat you differently because of it. When you leverage your notoriety to get what you want, you can **mark a Stress** before you roll to gain a +10 bonus to the result. Your food and drinks are always free wherever you go, and everything else you buy is reduced in price by one bag of gold (to a minimum of one handful).

This card doesn’t count against your loadout’s domain card maximum of 5 and can’t be placed in your vault.

rollOptions.label: Leverage notoriety
rollOptions.description: Only when leveraging your notoriety; prices/vault restriction are manual.

entries.name: Octarine Brace
entries.text:
Contaminated Brace

When you mark an Armor Slot to reduce incoming damage, you can give the GM a Fear to mark any number of additional Armor Slots.

mitigation.label: Octarine Brace
mitigation.description: Give the GM a Fear to mark any number of Armor Slots.

Contaminated Manifest Wall

Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per rest on a success, give the GM a Fear to create a temporary wall of octarine magic between two points within Far range. It can be up to 50 feet high and form at any angle. Creatures or objects in its path gain a level of contamination and are shunted to a side of your choice.

 A creature that touches the wall must make a Reaction Roll (14) or take d12 magic damage using your Proficiency. The wall stays up until your next rest or you cast Octarine Wall again.

report.text: The creature makes Reaction (14); on failure, it takes this magic damage.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Successful Octarine Wall: give the GM Fear

report.text: Give the GM 1 Fear to create the wall. Creatures or objects in its path gain a level of contamination and are shunted to a side of your choice.

entries.name: On the Brink
entries.text: When you have 2 or fewer Hit Points unmarked, you don’t take Minor damage.

mitigation.label: On the Brink
mitigation.description: With 2 or fewer Hit Points unmarked you don't take Minor damage.

entries.name: Onslaught
entries.text:
When you successfully make an attack with your weapon, you never deal damage beneath a target’s Major damage threshold (the target always marks a minimum of 2 Hit Points).

Additionally, when a creature within your weapon’s range deals damage to an ally with an attack that doesn’t include you, you can **mark a Stress** to force them to make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, the target must mark a Hit Point.

entries.name: Otherworldly Shimmer
entries.text:
Contaminated Hypnotic Shimmer

Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries in front of you within Close range. Once per rest on a success, create an illusion of otherworldly colors and lights that temporarily Enthralls targets you succeed against. While Enthralled, they cannot use reactions and cannot take any other actions until they clear the condition. You can give the GM a Fear to make an *Enthralled* target mark 1d4 Stress, once per target.

entries.name: Overwhelming Aura
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (15)** to magically empower your aura. On a success, **spend 2 Hope** to make your Presence equal to your Spellcast trait until your next long rest.

While this spell is active, an adversary must mark a Stress when they target you with an attack.

entries.name: Parasite of the Will
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a creature within Very Far range. On a success, **mark a Hit Point** to conjure a tiny magical bloodworm that burrows into the target. On a success with Hope, the target isn’t aware of the worm within.

You have advantage on any Presence roll against the target, and whenever they make a roll, you can **spend a Hope** to give the roll disadvantage. You can destroy the bloodworm to cause the target to mark a Hit Point.

entries.name: Phantom Retreat
entries.text: **Spend a Hope** to activate Phantom Retreat where you’re currently standing. **Spend another Hope** at any time before your next rest to disappear from where you are and reappear where you were standing when you activated Phantom Retreat. This spell ends after you reappear.

toggleEffect.name: Phantom Retreat
toggleEffect.text: Activate Phantom Retreat again, spending another Hope, to return to the original location and end this effect.

entries.name: Pick and Pull
entries.text: You have advantage on action rolls to pick nonmagical locks, disarm nonmagical traps, or steal items from a target (either through stealth or by force).

rollOptions.label: Pick and Pull
rollOptions.description: Use when picking a nonmagical lock, disarming a nonmagical trap, or stealing an item.

entries.name: Plant Dominion
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (18)**. Once per long rest on a success, you reshape the natural world, changing the surrounding plant life anywhere within Far range of you. For example, you can grow trees instantly, clear a path through dense vines, or create a wall of roots.

entries.name: Power Through Pain
entries.text: If you have at least one Hit Point marked, you gain a bonus to your damage rolls. The bonus equals twice your number of marked Hit Points.

entries.name: Premonition
entries.text: You can channel arcane energy to have visions of the future. Once per long rest, immediately after the GM conveys the consequences of a roll you made, you can rescind the move and consequences like they never happened and make another move instead.

entries.name: Preservation Blast
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against all targets within Melee range. Targets you succeed against are forced back to Far range and take **d8+3** magic damage using your Spellcast trait.

entries.name: Rage Up
entries.text:
Before you make an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to twice your Strength.

You can Rage Up twice per attack.

entries.name: Rain of Blades
entries.text:
**Spend a Hope** to make a **Spellcast Roll** and conjure throwing blades that strike out at all targets within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against take **d8+2** magic damage using your Proficiency.

If a target you hit is *Vulnerable*, they take an extra **1d8** damage.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Rain of Blades: roll d8+2 magic damage

entries.name: Rapid Riposte
entries.text: When an attack made against you from within Melee range fails, you can **mark a Stress** and seize the opportunity to deal the weapon damage of one of your active weapons to the attacker.

entries.name: Reaper’s Strike
entries.text: Once per long rest, **spend a Hope** to make an attack roll. The GM tells you which targets within range it would succeed against. Choose one of these targets and force them to mark 5 Hit Points.

rollOptions.label: Reaper’s Strike
rollOptions.description: The GM identifies targets in range this roll succeeds against; choose one to mark 5 HP.

entries.name: Reassurance
entries.text: Once per rest, after an ally attempts an action roll but before the consequences take place, you can offer assistance or words of support. When you do, your ally can reroll their dice.

entries.name: Reckless
entries.text: **Mark a Stress** to gain advantage on an attack.

entries.name: Recovery
entries.text: During a short rest, you can choose a long rest downtime move instead. You can **spend a Hope** to let an ally do the same.

passives.label: Spend 1 Hope: allow an ally one long-rest move

entries.name: Redirect
entries.text: When an attack made against you from beyond Melee range fails, roll a number of **d6s** equal to your Proficiency. If any roll a 6, you can **mark a Stress** to redirect the attack to damage an adversary within Very Close range instead.

rollTriggers.label: Redirect attack to adversary within Very Close range

entries.name: Rejuvenation Barrier
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (15)**. Once per rest on a success, create a temporary barrier of protective energy around you at Very Close range. You and all allies within the barrier when this spell is cast clear **1d4** Hit Points. While the barrier is up, you and all allies within have resistance to physical damage from outside the barrier.

When you move, the barrier follows you.

effect.name: Rejuvenation Barrier
effect.text: Dismiss when the barrier ends or you leave it. Only physical damage originating outside the barrier is resisted.

mitigation.label: Inside Rejuvenation Barrier; damage from outside

chatBenefits.label: Within barrier when cast: heal d4 HP and gain barrier benefit

effect.name: Rejuvenation Barrier
effect.text: Dismiss when the barrier ends or you leave it. Only physical damage originating outside the barrier is resisted.

mitigation.label: Inside Rejuvenation Barrier; damage from outside

entries.name: Restoration
entries.text:
After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. Touch a creature and spend any number of tokens to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress for each token spent.

You can also spend a token from this card when touching a creature to clear the *Vulnerable* condition or heal a physical or magical ailment (the GM might require additional tokens depending on the strength of the ailment).

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

actions.label: Touch creature: heal or clear condition

entries.name: Resurrection
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (20)**. On a success, restore one creature who has been dead no longer than 100 years to full strength. Then roll a **d6**. On a result of 5 or lower, place this card in your vault permanently.

On a failure, you can’t cast Resurrection again for a week.

entries.name: Rift Walker
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll (15)**. On a success, you place an arcane marking on the ground where you currently stand. The next time you successfully cast Rift Walker, a rift in space opens up, providing safe passage back to the exact spot where the marking was placed. This rift stays open until you choose to close it or you cast another spell.

You can drop the spell at any time to cast Rift Walker again and place the marking somewhere new.

entries.name: Rise Up
entries.text:
Gain a bonus to your Severe threshold equal to your Proficiency.

When you mark 1 or more Hit Points from an attack, clear a Stress.

entries.name: Rousing Strike
entries.text: Once per rest, when you critically succeed on an attack, you and all allies who can see or hear you can clear a Hit Point or **1d4** Stress.

entries.name: Rune Ward
entries.text:
You have a deeply personal trinket that can be infused with protective magic and held as a ward by you or an ally. Describe what it is and why it’s important to you. The ward’s holder can spend a Hope to reduce incoming damage by **1d8**.

If the Ward Die result is 8, the ward’s power ends after it reduces damage this turn. It can be recharged for free on your next rest.

entries.name: Runic Adrenaline
entries.text:
Your practice of blood magic has seeped into your bloodstream, enhancing your vitals in moments of urgency. When you roll with advantage, use a **d8** instead of a d6 as your advantage die if you have 1 or more Hit Points marked.

After you make a Strength, an Agility, or a Finesse roll, you can **mark a Hit Point** to roll 1d8 and add it to the result.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Runic Adrenaline: mark HP, add d8
Runic Adrenaline: mark HP, add d8
Runic Adrenaline: mark HP, add d8

entries.name: Safe Haven
entries.text:
When you have a few minutes of calm to focus, you can **spend 2 Hope** to summon your Safe Haven, a large interdimensional home where you and your allies can take shelter. When you do, a magical door appears somewhere within Close range. Only creatures of your choice can enter. Once inside, you can make the entrance invisible. You and anyone else inside can always exit. Once you leave, the doorway must be summoned again.

When you take a rest within your own Safe Haven, you can choose an additional downtime move.

effect.name: Safe Haven
effect.text: Resting inside Safe Haven grants one additional downtime move. Ends after your next rest.

effect.name: Safe Haven
effect.text: Resting inside Safe Haven grants one additional downtime move. Ends after your next rest.

report.text: Summoned Safe Haven for 2 Hope. Eligible allies can enter using this message and gain one additional downtime move for their next rest.

entries.name: Sage-Touched
entries.text:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Sage domain, gain the following benefits:

- While you’re in a natural environment, you gain a +2 bonus to your Spellcast Rolls.
- Once per rest, you can double your Agility or Instinct when making a roll that uses that trait. You must choose to do this before you roll.

entries.name: Salvation Beam
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (16)**. On a success, **mark any number of Stress** to target a line of allies within Far range. You can clear Hit Points on the targets equal to the number of Stress marked, divided among them however you’d like.

entries.name: Sanguine Feast
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against an adversary within Close range. On a success, **spend 2 Hope** to mark 1–3 Hit Points, and the target marks twice the number of the Hit Points you marked. If this causes the target to mark their last Hit Point, you can clear the Hit Points you marked to cast this spell.

report.text: The target marks 2 HP. If this marks its last HP, recover the 1 HP paid using this message.
The target marks 4 HP. If this marks its last HP, recover the 2 HP paid using this message.

entries.name: Savor the Anguish
entries.text: When an adversary within Close range takes Severe damage, you can clear a Stress.

actions.label: Nearby adversary takes Severe damage: clear Stress

entries.name: Scramble
entries.text: Once per rest, when a creature within Melee range would deal damage to you, you can avoid the attack and safely move out of Melee range of the enemy.

entries.name: Second Wind
entries.text: Once per rest, when you succeed on an attack against an adversary, you can clear 3 Stress or a Hit Point. On a success with Hope, you also clear 3 Stress or a Hit Point on an ally within Close range of you.

entries.name: Sensory Projection
entries.text: Once per rest, make a **Spellcast Roll (15)**. On a success, drop into a vision that lets you clearly see and hear any place you have been before as though you are standing there in this moment. You can move freely in this vision and are not constrained by the physics or impediments of a physical body. This spell cannot be detected by mundane or magical means. You drop out of this vision upon taking damage or casting another spell.

entries.name: Shadowbind
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against all adversaries within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against are temporarily *Restrained* as their shadow binds them in place.

entries.name: Shadowhunter
entries.text: Your prowess is enhanced under the cover of shadow. While you’re shrouded in low light or darkness, you gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion and make attack rolls with advantage.

conditionalActions.label: Shadowhunter: enter low light or darkness

effect.name: Shadowhunter: shrouded
effect.text: End this effect when no longer shrouded in low light or darkness.

entries.name: Shape Material
entries.text:
**Spend a Hope** to shape a section of natural material you’re touching (such as stone, ice, or wood) to suit your purpose. The area of the material can be no larger than you. For example, you can form a rudimentary tool or create a door.

You can only affect the material within Close range of where you’re touching it.

entries.name: Share the Burden
entries.text: Once per rest, take on the Stress from a willing creature within Melee range. The target describes what intimate knowledge or emotions telepathically leak from their mind in this moment between you. Transfer any number of their marked Stress to you, then gain a Hope for each Stress transferred.

report.text: One willing creature within Melee range can transfer marked Stress to you. Gain 1 Hope for each Stress received.

entries.name: Shared Trauma
entries.text: You can transfer suffering from one creature to another. Once per rest, mark any number of Hit Points on a willing creature within Melee range to clear an equal number of Hit Points on another willing creature within Melee range.

entries.name: Shield Aura
entries.text:
**Mark a Stress** to cast a protective aura on a target within Very Close range. When the target marks an Armor Slot, they reduce the severity of the attack by an additional threshold. If this spell causes a creature who would be damaged to instead mark no Hit Points, the effect ends.

You can only hold Shield Aura on one creature at a time.

effect.name: Shield Aura
effect.text: When the chosen actor marks an Armor Slot, reduce the attack's severity by one additional threshold. Ends if this reduction prevents all HP marking, or the caster casts Shield Aura again.

entries.name: Shrug It Off
entries.text: When you would take damage, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the severity of the damage by one threshold. When you do, roll a **d6**. On a result of 3 or lower, place this card in your vault.

followUp.text: on 3 or lower, place this card in your vault

entries.name: Sigil of Retribution

actions.label: Marked adversary dealt damage: add d8

rollOptions.label: Sigil: roll ALL d8s
rollOptions.description: Only a successful attack against the marked adversary.

entries.text: Mark an adversary within Close range with a sigil of retribution. The GM gains a Fear. When the marked adversary deals damage to you or your allies, place a **d8** on this card. You can hold a number of **d8s** equal to your level. When you successfully attack the marked adversary, roll the dice on this card and add the total to your damage roll, then clear the dice. This effect ends when the marked adversary is defeated or you cast Sigil of Retribution again.

entries.name: Signature Move
entries.text: Name and describe your signature combat move. Once per rest, when you perform this signature move as part of an action you’re taking, you can roll a** d20** as your Hope Die. On a success, clear a Stress.

rollOptions.label: Signature Move
rollOptions.description: Only when performing your named signature combat move.

entries.name: Siphon Essence
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Very Close range. Once per long rest on a success, the target takes **d12+4** magic damage using your Proficiency. On a success with Fear, you gain a **+1** bonus to your Proficiency for this attack.

You clear a number of Hit Points equal to the number of Hit Points the target marked from this attack.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Siphon Essence: roll d12+4 damage (once per long rest)
