entries.name: Smite
entries.text: Once per rest, **spend 3 Hope** to charge your powerful smite. When you next successfully attack with a weapon, double the result of your damage roll. This attack deals magic damage regardless of the weapon’s damage type.

effect.name: Smite
effect.text: Use on the damage roll of your next successful weapon attack.

entries.name: Soothing Speech
entries.text: During a short rest, when you take the time to comfort another character while using the Tend to Wounds downtime move on them, clear an additional Hit Point on that character. When you do, you also clear 2 Hit Points.

entries.name: Specter of the Dark
entries.text: **Mark a Stress** to become *Spectral *until you make an action roll targeting another creature. While *Spectral*, you’re immune to physical damage and can float and pass through solid objects. Other creatures can still see you while you’re in this form.

effect.name: Specter of the Dark
effect.text: End this effect when you make an action roll targeting another creature.

entries.name: Spectral Mist
entries.text: **Spend 2 Hope** to conjure an eerie mist that turns you and allies of your choice within Close range momentarily incorporeal. While a creature is incorporeal, they can move through solid objects and are immune to physical damage. They become corporeal again after they pass through a solid object or make an action roll. Otherwise, this effect lasts until the end of the scene.

entries.name: Spellcharge
entries.text:
When you take magic damage, place tokens equal to the number of Hit Points you marked on this card. You can store a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait.

When you make a successful attack against a target, you can spend any number of tokens to add a **d6** for each token spent to your damage roll.

entries.name: Splendor-Touched
entries.text:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Splendor domain, gain the following benefits:

- +3 bonus to your Severe damage threshold
- Once per long rest, when incoming damage would require you to mark a number of Hit Points, you can choose to mark that much Stress or spend that much Hope instead.

conditionalMitigation.label: Splendor-Touched: mark Stress instead
conditionalMitigation.description: Mark Stress equal to the Hit Points you would mark instead.

conditionalMitigation.label: Splendor-Touched: spend Hope instead
conditionalMitigation.description: Spend Hope equal to the Hit Points you would mark instead.

entries.name: Splintering Strike
entries.text: **Spend a Hope** and make an attack against all adversaries within your weapon’s range. Once per long rest, on a success against any targets, roll your weapon's damage and distribute that damage however you wish between the targets you succeeded against. Before you deal damage to each target, roll an additional damage die and add its result to the damage you deal to them.

entries.name: Stealth Expertise
entries.text:
When you roll with Fear while attempting to move unnoticed through a dangerous area, you can **mark a Stress** to roll with Hope instead.

If an ally within Close range is also attempting to move unnoticed and rolls with Fear, you can **mark a Stress** to change their result to a roll with Hope.

rollTriggers.label: Stealth Expertise: change Fear into Hope
rollTriggers.description: You or an ally within Close range rolling to move unnoticed through a dangerous area.

entries.name: Strategic Approach
entries.text:
After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to your Knowledge on this card (minimum 1). The first time you move within Close range of an adversary and make an attack against them, you can spend one token to choose one of the following options:

- You make the attack with advantage.
- You clear a Stress on an ally within Melee range of the adversary.
- You add a **d8** to your damage roll.
When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

actions.label: First Close attack: clear eligible ally Stress

rollOptions.label: Strategic Approach: first Close attack advantage
rollOptions.description: Only the first Close attack against this adversary; choose one card benefit, not the ally Stress or damage benefit too.

rollOptions.label: Strategic Approach: +d8 damage
rollOptions.description: Only the first Close attack against this adversary, if you did not choose advantage or ally Stress clearing.

entries.name: Stunning Sunlight

actions.label: Successful Sunlight: pay for one target

report.text: One target you succeeded against makes Reaction (14). Repeat for each additional target.
The failed target is temporarily Stunned; the GM manages the condition.

entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** to unleash powerful rays of burning sunlight against all adversaries in front of you within Far range. On a success, **spend any number of Hope** and force that many targets you succeeded against to make a Reaction Roll (14).

Targets who succeed take **3d20+3** magic damage. Targets who fail take **4d20+5** magic damage and are temporarily *Stunned*. While *Stunned*, they can’t use reactions and can’t take any other actions until they clear this condition.

entries.name: Summon Horror
entries.text:
Once per scene, **
mark a Stress
**to summon an otherworldly creature that deals **d8+1**
magic damage using your Spellcast trait to a target within Far range. If the target marks any Hit Points from this attack, they must succeed on a **Reaction Roll (12)** to steel themselves against the horror or mark an equal number of Stress.

After making the attack, the creature dissipates.

entries.name: Support Tank
entries.text: When an ally within Close range fails a roll, you can **spend 2 Hope** to allow them to reroll either their Hope or Fear Die.

entries.name: Swift Step
entries.text: When an attack made against you fails, clear a Stress. If you can’t clear a Stress, gain a Hope.

actions.label: Attack fails and no Stress to clear: gain Hope

entries.name: Tactician

rollOptions.label: Tactician: Tag Team Hope d20
rollOptions.description: Only for a Tag Team Roll. The ally manually adds your applicable Experience when you Help them.

entries.text:
When you Help an Ally, they can spend a Hope to add one of your Experiences to their roll alongside your advantage die.

When making a Tag Team Roll, you can roll a **d20** as your Hope Die.

entries.name: Telekinesis
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Far range. On a success, you can use your mind to move them anywhere within Far range of their original position. You can throw the lifted target as an attack by making an additional Spellcast Roll against the second target you’re trying to attack. On a success, deal** d12+4** physical damage to the second target using your Proficiency. This spell then ends.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.text:
Once per long rest, you can instantly teleport yourself and any number of willing targets within Close range to a place you’ve been before. Choose one of the following options, then make a **Spellcast Roll (16)**:

- If you know the place very well, gain a +3 bonus.
- If you’ve visited the place frequently, gain a +1 bonus.
- If you’ve visited the place infrequently, gain no modifier.
- If you’ve only been there once, gain a −2 penalty.
On a success, you appear where you were intending to go. On a failure, you appear off course, with the range of failure determining how far off course.

entries.name: Tell No Lies
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll **against a target within Very Close range. On a success, they can’t lie to you while they remain within Close range, but they are not compelled to speak. If you ask them a question and they refuse to answer, they must mark a Stress and the effect ends. The target is typically unaware this spell has been cast on them until it causes them to utter the truth.

entries.name: Tempest
entries.text:
Choose one of the following tempests and make a **Spellcast Roll** against all targets within Far range. Targets you succeed against experience its effects until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to end this spell.

- ***Blizzard:*** Deal **2d20+8** magic damage and targets are temporarily *Vulnerable*.
- ***Hurricane: ***Deal **3d10+10** magic damage and choose a direction the wind is blowing. Targets can’t move against the wind.
- ***Sandstorm:*** Deal **5d6+9** magic damage. Attacks made from beyond Melee range have disadvantage.

entries.name: Terrify

report.text: The GM marks this Stress, resolves fleeing, and applies Vulnerable on a Fear success.

entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Close range. On a success, the target marks **1d4** Stress, and you can make the target flee one range away from you (such as Very Close to Close or Close to Far). On a success with Fear, the target also becomes temporarily *Vulnerable*.

entries.name: Thorn Skin
entries.text:
Once per rest, **spend a Hope** to sprout thorns all over your body. When you do, place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. When you take damage, you can spend any number of tokens to roll that number of **d6s**. Add the results together and reduce the incoming damage by that amount. If you’re within Melee range of the attacker, deal that amount of damage back to them.

When you take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.

effect.name: Thorn Skin
effect.text: Spend tokens in incoming damage to reduce it by d6 per token; retaliate when in Melee range.

mitigation.label: Thorn Skin
mitigation.description: Spend tokens to reduce the damage by a d6 each.

entries.name: Thought Delver
entries.text:
You can peek into the minds of others. **Spend a Hope** to read the vague surface thoughts of a target within Far range. Make a**Spellcast Roll **against the target to delve for deeper, more hidden thoughts.

On a roll with Fear, the target might, at the GM’s discretion, become aware that you’re reading their thoughts.

entries.name: Through Your Eyes
entries.text: Choose a target within Very Far range. You can see through their eyes and hear through their ears. You can transition between using your own senses or the target’s freely until you cast another spell or until your next rest.

entries.name: Towering Stalk
entries.text:
Once per rest, you can conjure a thick, twisting stalk within Close range that can be easily climbed. Its height can grow up to Far range.

**Mark a Stress** to use this spell as an attack. Make a **Spellcast Roll** against an adversary or group of adversaries within Close range. The erupting stalk lifts targets you succeed against into the air and drops them, dealing **d8** physical damage using your Proficiency.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Towering Stalk: roll d8 physical damage

entries.name: Transcendent Union
entries.text: Once per long rest, **spend 5 Hope** to cast this spell on two or more willing creatures. Until your next rest, when a creature connected by this union would mark Stress or Hit Points, the connected creatures can choose who marks it.

entries.name: Troublemaker
entries.text: When you taunt or provoke a target within Far range, make a **Presence Roll** against them. Once per rest on a success, roll a number of **d4s** equal to your Proficiency. The target must mark Stress equal to the highest result rolled.

report.text: The target marks {result} Stress, equal to the highest d4 rolled.

entries.name: Twilight Toll
entries.text:
Choose a target within Far range. When you succeed on an action roll against them that doesn’t result in making a damage roll, place a token on this card. When you deal damage to this target, spend any number of tokens to add a** d12** for each token spent to your damage roll. You can only hold Twilight Toll on one creature at a time.

When you choose a new target or take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.

actions.label: Successful non-damaging action against chosen target: gain token
New target or rest: clear tokens

rollOptions.label: Twilight Toll token
rollOptions.description: Only damage to the chosen target.

entries.name: Umbral Veil
entries.text:
Once per rest, you can **mark a Stress** to encase yourself in shadowy energy. When you do, place a number of tokens on this card equal to the number of Fear in the GM’s pool. After an attack roll is made against you, you can spend any number of tokens to give the result a −1 penalty per token spent.

At the end of the scene, clear all unspent tokens.

actions.label: Encase in shadow (tokens = Fear in the GM pool)
Spend token: -1 to an attack roll

entries.name: Unbreakable
entries.text: When you mark your last Hit Point, instead of making a death move, you can roll a **d6** and clear a number of Hit Points equal to the result. Then place this card in your vault.

entries.name: Uncanny Disguise
entries.text:
When you have a few minutes to prepare, you can **mark a Stress** to don the facade of any humanoid you can picture clearly in your mind. While disguised, you have advantage on Presence Rolls to avoid scrutiny.

Place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. When you take an action while disguised, spend a token from this card. After the action that spends the last token is resolved, the disguise drops.

effect.name: Uncanny Disguise
effect.text: While disguised, spend a token on each action roll, not reactions. The disguise ends after the last token is spent. Advantage on Presence rolls to avoid scrutiny.

entries.name: Uncanny Focus
entries.text:
Contaminated Deadly Focus

Once per rest, you can apply otherworldly focus toward a target of your choice. Until you attack another creature, you defeat your target, or the battle ends, gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. When you force the target to mark HP, you may give the GM a Fear to force the target to mark an additional HP.

effect.name: Uncanny Focus
effect.text: End this effect if you attack another creature, defeat the target, or the battle ends. The extra HP and GM Fear are handled at the table.

entries.name: Unleash Chaos
entries.text:
At the beginning of a session, place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card.

Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Far range and spend any number of tokens to channel raw energy from within yourself to unleash against them. On a success, roll a number of** d10s** equal to the tokens you spent and deal that much magic damage to the target. **Mark a Stress** to replenish this card with tokens (up to your Spellcast trait).

At the end of each session, clear all unspent tokens.

entries.name: Untouchable
entries.text: Gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to half your Agility.

entries.name: Unyielding Armor
entries.text: When you would mark an Armor Slot, roll a number of **d6s** equal to your Proficiency. If any roll a 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

mitigation.label: Unyielding Armor
mitigation.description: Roll d6s equal to your Proficiency; on any 6 reduce severity without marking the Armor Slot.

entries.name: Valor-Touched
entries.text:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Valor domain, gain the following benefits:

- +1 bonus to your Armor Score
- When you mark 1 or more Hit Points without marking an Armor Slot, clear an Armor Slot.

entries.name: Vampiric Strike
entries.text: When you make a successful attack roll against an adversary and cause them to mark 2 or more Hit Points, you can **spend a Hope** to clear a Hit Point or Stress.

entries.name: Vanishing Dodge
entries.text: When an attack made against you that would deal physical damage fails, you can **spend a Hope** to envelop yourself in shadow, becoming *Hidden* and teleporting to a point within Close range of the attacker. You remain *Hidden* until the next time you make an action roll.

effect.name: Hidden
effect.text: Any rolls against a Hidden creature have disadvantage. Remove this effect manually when no longer Hidden.

entries.name: Veil of Night
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (13)**. On a success, you can create a temporary curtain of darkness between two points within Far range. Only you can see through this darkness. You’re considered *Hidden* to adversaries on the other side of the veil, and you have advantage on attacks you make through the darkness. The veil remains until you cast another spell.

entries.name: Versatile Fighter
entries.text:
You can use a different character trait for an equipped weapon, rather than the trait the weapon calls for.

When you deal damage, you can **mark a Stress** to use the maximum result of one of your damage dice instead of rolling it.

rollOptions.label: Versatile Fighter: maximize a damage die

entries.name: Vicious Entangle
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Far range. On a success, roots and vines reach out from the ground, dealing **1d8+1** physical damage and temporarily *Restraining* the target.

Additionally on a success, you can **spend a Hope** to temporarily *Restrain* another adversary within Very Close range of your target.

report.text: Temporarily Restrain another adversary within Very Close range of the original target.

entries.name: Vital Ward
entries.text: **Mark a Hit Point** to trace a circle of blood around yourself at Very Close range. While in the circle, you have resistance to your choice of physical or magic damage (choose when you cast the spell). Allies also gain this benefit while in the circle. The circle disappears if you move out of it, mark 2 or more Hit Points, or cast this spell again.

effect.name: Vital Ward
effect.text: Physical resistance within the circle. End when you leave the circle or mark 2 or more HP.

effect.name: Vital Ward benefits
effect.text: Physical resistance while within the caster's circle. Remove when you leave; ends automatically when the caster's circle ends.

effect.name: Vital Ward
effect.text: Magic resistance within the circle. End when you leave the circle or mark 2 or more HP.

effect.name: Vital Ward benefits
effect.text: Magic resistance while within the caster's circle. Remove when you leave; ends automatically when the caster's circle ends.

entries.name: Vitality
entries.text:
When you choose this card, permanently gain two of the following benefits:

- One Stress slot
- One Hit Point slot
- +2 bonus to your damage thresholds
Then place this card in your vault permanently.

entries.name: Vitality Manipulation
entries.text:
Make a **Spellcast Roll** against a target within Very Close range. If you cast this on an ally, make the roll with advantage. On a success, **mark a Stress**, and choose one of the following effects:

- The target grows calmer and clears a Stress. On a success with Hope, they clear 2 Stress.
- The target grows more anxious and marks a Stress. On a success with Hope, they mark 2 Stress.

report.text: The target grows calmer and clears 1 Stress.
The target grows more anxious and marks 1 Stress.
The target grows calmer and clears 2 Stress.
The target grows more anxious and marks 2 Stress.

entries.name: Voice of Dread
entries.text: You can magically speak to a creature you can see, tormenting them with your words. Make a **Spellcast Roll** against them. On a success, they must mark a Stress and are frozen with terror, making them temporarily *Restrained*.

entries.name: Voice of Reason
entries.text:
You speak with an unmatched power and authority. You have advantage on action rolls to de-escalate violent situations or convince someone to follow your lead.

Additionally, you’re emboldened in moments of duress. When all of your Stress slots are marked, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for damage rolls.

conditionalRollOptions.label: Voice of Reason: de-escalate or lead
conditionalRollOptions.description: Use when de-escalating violence or convincing someone to follow your lead.

entries.name: Wall of Hunger
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (10)**. On a success, you can **spend a Hope** to create a visible wall of writhing necrotic energy between two points within Far range. The wall lasts until you mark a Hit Point or cast this spell again. A creature inside the wall when it appears or that passes through it must mark 2 Stress.

entries.name: Wall Walk
entries.text: **Spend a Hope** to allow a creature you can touch to climb on walls and ceilings as easily as walking on the ground. This lasts until the end of the scene or you cast Wall Walk again.

effect.name: Wall Walk
effect.text: Climb walls and ceilings as easily as walking. Ends at scene end or when this caster casts Wall Walk again.

entries.name: Weave the Flesh
entries.text: Once per rest, **mark a Hit Point** to allow each ally within Close range to clear a Hit Point or a Stress. You can **mark a Stress** to allow those allies to clear one of each.

actions.label: Weave the Flesh: allies clear HP or Stress
Weave the Flesh: allies clear HP and Stress

chatBenefits.label: Within Close range: clear 1 HP and 1 Stress

entries.name: Whirlwind
entries.text: When you make a successful attack against a target within Very Close range, you can **spend a Hope** to use the attack against all other targets within Very Close range. All additional adversaries you succeed against with this ability take half damage.

conditionalRollTriggers.label: Whirlwind

report.text: Use this attack against all other targets within Very Close range; additional adversaries hit take half damage.

conditionalRollTriggers.description: Use the attack against other targets within Very Close range; additional adversaries hit take half damage.

entries.name: Wild Fortress
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (13)**. On a success, **spend 2 Hope** to grow a natural barricade in the shape of a dome that you and one ally can take cover within. While inside the dome, a creature can’t be targeted by attacks and can’t make attacks. Attacks made against the dome automatically succeed. The dome has a Major damage threshold of 15 and a Severe damage threshold of 30, and lasts until it marks 3 Hit Points. Place tokens on this card to represent marking Hit Points.

entries.name: Wild Surge
entries.text:
Once per long rest, **mark a Stress** to channel the natural world around you and enhance yourself. Describe how your appearance changes, then place a **d6** on this card with the 1 value facing up.

While the Wild Surge Die is active, you add its value to every action roll you make. After you add its value to a roll, increase the Wild Surge Die’s value by one. When the die’s value would exceed 6 or you take a rest, this form drops and you must **mark an additional Stress**.

entries.name: Words of Discord

rollOptions.label: Words of Discord: repeat target
rollOptions.description: Use when casting again on a target that has realized what happened.

entries.text:
Whisper words of discord to an adversary within Melee range and make a **Spellcast Roll (13)**. On a success, the target must mark a Stress and make an attack against another adversary instead of against you or your allies.

Once this attack is over, the target realizes what happened. The next time you cast Words of Discord on them, gain a −5 penalty to the Spellcast Roll.

entries.name: Wrangle
entries.text: Make an Agility Roll against all targets within Close range.** Spend a Hope** to move targets you succeed against, and any willing allies within Close range, to another point within Close range.

rollTriggers.label: Wrangle: move successful targets and willing allies

entries.name: Zone of Protection
entries.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (16)**. Once per long rest on a success, choose a point within Far range and create a visible zone of protection there for all allies within Very Close range of that point. When you do, place a **d6** on this card with the 1 value facing up. When an ally in this zone takes damage, they reduce it by the die’s value. You then increase the die’s value by one. When the die’s value would exceed 6, this effect ends.
